# opnsense_bind_primary_domain_transfer (Resource)

Attaches secondary-transfer settings to an existing BIND primary zone without owning the zone itself. Delete removes only the transfer attachment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `also_notify` (Set of String) Secondary nameserver addresses that receive NOTIFY.
- `domain_id` (String) UUID of the existing primary zone.
- `transfer_key_id` (String) UUID of the TSIG key used for authenticated AXFR/IXFR and NOTIFY.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Attachment identity; equal to domain_id.
